# Claude Cowork

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Agentic interface for Claude AI that works directly with files, apps, and scheduled tasks.

## Scope note

- Available on paid plans for Claude Desktop (macOS, Windows), web, and mobile.
- Cowork completes work rather than describing it.
- Works with files in folders granted access; can run scheduled tasks unattended.

## Broader

- [Claude AI](../ClaudeAI/)
